fields.label: Location
values: Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands; London, England, United Kingdom; Remote - Germany
fields.note: Rendered as the #gh-location <select> of the embedded Greenhouse job board. The values are its own option values (slugs such as 'houston-texas-united-states'); the board script filters the rendered cards client-side and sends no request.

fields.label: Department
fields.note: Rendered as the #gh-department <select>; option values are slugs ('sales', 'product--engineering', 'general--administration', 'consulting', 'customer-value'). Client-side display filter only.

notes: The ledger URL redirects to https://www.highradius.com/about/career/, which embeds the Greenhouse board script (boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board/js?for=highradius). Every card links to /about/careers-list/?gh_jid=<id>. The only controls are the #gh-location and #gh-department selects plus a name="search" box; all three filter the rendered cards in the browser and none is sent to an API. The board API (boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/highradius/jobs?content=true) takes no keyword/facet/sort parameter, so all filtering is local.
evidence: https://www.highradius.com/about/careers/ -> https://www.highradius.com/about/career/ (200) with id="gh-location" and id="gh-department" option lists
